denial.payer_remark: Records of conservative treatment are required.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-02-03
Patient: 71-year-old woman, established patient.
Chief complaint: left knee pain from osteoarthritis
Radiograph of the left knee, 2025-07-18: joint-space narrowing and osteophytes, consistent with osteoarthritis.
Naproxen 500 mg twice daily started 2025-09-27; still taking it with little relief.
Supervised physical therapy: 11 sessions from 2025-10-11 to 2025-12-06; pain unchanged.
Examination: crepitus, small effusion, flexion limited to 100 degrees.
Procedure: hyaluronan injected into the left knee.
Signed: treating clinician. 2026-02-03.

expected.rationale: The note has a confirming radiograph, and dated analgesic treatment and physical therapy running about 4 months before the injection. This payer requires 3 months, so the requested records exist and meet the clause.
